Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Short request: temporary credit allowance for paused PoC

Hi Lukas,

Appreciate you taking the time on Friday. Quick note from our side — we had to pause the PoC for hiring reasons on our end and procurement had to reprioritize the SOW. The eval work is otherwise ready to pick back up and we have an internal demo tentatively scheduled for the first week of September, but we need a small bucket of credits to finish the walkthrough and final tests.

Can Redwood provide a short-term safety allowance for the OxygenAI sandbox? We're asking for 150,000 token-equivalent credits (approximate run rate attached) for ~45 days to cover the remaining tests and the demo. If that’s not possible, a 30-day, 100k token allotment would still get us across the line.

We understand this is an exception — we’re happy to sign any one-page terms and convert to a paid pilot once procurement clears.

Attachment: oxygen-eval-summary.xlsx (xlsx) — quick cost breakdown and remaining scenarios to run.

Thanks,
Sahil Mehta
Sr. ML Engineer, OxygenAI
sahil@oxygenai.com
(415) 555-0198

Thanks for the context, Lukas. Happy to approve a one-time safety-net of 100,000 token-equivalent credits for OxygenAI for 30 days.
